## Specific task description

Task instruction: Reach and grab the roller with tapered tips with both arms

Task description: The target is the light-brown rolling pin lying diagonally at the front of the table, tapering toward both ends. Grasp it with both arms and lift it off the table.

Success criteria: Both arms must hold the rolling pin with both grippers closed, lifted clearly above the table with visible height clearance. Merely grasping it or barely clearing the table is insufficient.

## Execution tips

- The two arms can grasp near opposite ends at locations inward from the narrowest tips, with enough finger-pad contact on the thicker shaft; avoid the thinnest tips where possible to reduce slipping and leave space between the grippers.
- Close the fingers across the rolling pin, perpendicular to its long axis, with an opening slightly wider than the grasp area. Before closing, confirm that the fingers are on opposite sides of the body rather than pressing only on its top surface.
- When lifting, coordinate the height changes at both grasp points and keep them spaced apart, avoiding one end rising first or the arms pulling against each other and shifting the rolling pin.
